description:
[Game reference] Every Rust achievement: exact unlock condition from the game code + global unlock %. `achievements` (most common first): `key` (Steam api name), `name`, `desc` (Steam's text), `pct` (share of all
Rust players who have it), `how` (the exact condition, from the server code; for `type` client it is Steam's text),
`type` (server_direct / server_field / steam_stat / client / new), `hidden`, `progress_max` + `stat` for counter
achievements, `items` (shortnames), `note` (caveats). `stats`: the counters the game tracks and what increments them.
`global_rules`: achievements only unlock on official servers. Use q= to find one. `how` is the exact condition from the game code (type client = Steam's text). Achievements only unlock on official servers. Link https://rust.wiki/achievements#<KEY>.

q.description: Filter by words in the name, description or key.

name: get_achievements
